ledger.x: 301: Cliopatria's Colchis shape begins; the Colchis page is silent on 301-231.

c. 110: Mithridates VI of Pontus conquers Colchis. 'Mithridates began his expansion by inheriting Lesser Armenia from King Antipater (precise date unknown, c.115–106) and by conquering the Kingdom of Colchis.' The page gives no year for Colchis; 110 is the middle of the Lesser Armenia range and matches the…

wars.name: Mithridates VI's conquest of Colchis
wars.outcome: Colchis passes to the Kingdom of Pontus; a revolt there was put down in 83 BC and Colchis was given to the king's son Mithridates (Colchis page).

certainty.note: No treaty or survey frontier is on the pages; Strabo's and Ptolemy's differing western limits (Trabzon, the Rioni) show the edge was approximate.
